elicitation_endpoint_health_check.description: Probe the MCP approval (elicitation) endpoint agents are pointed at

github_merge_conflict_poller.description: Poll GitHub PRs for merge conflicts and notify sessions

token_usage_ingestion.description: Sweep recent transcripts into the token-spend ledger

token_usage_backfill.description: Sweep the whole transcript corpus into the ledger once, a slice at a time, so history needs no shell on the box

post_deploy_tasks.description: Run the one-time post-deploy tasks in db/post_deploy, so an ops step ships with the deploy instead of needing a shell

experimental_flag_backfill.description: Label pre-tracking sessions with what each experimental setting was, so the Costs experiment report has history

cli_status_refresh.description: Refresh CLI tool status cache (gh, claude, fly)

catalog_refresh.description: Refresh catalog repo (skills, servers, agent roots) from tadasant/zimmer-catalog

queue_recovery_mode_expiry.description: Lift queue recovery mode once its TTL has elapsed (runs on `agents`, the queue recovery mode never pauses)

slack_trigger_poller.description: Poll Slack channels for triggers and create sessions

github_trigger_poller.description: Poll GitHub for label-added and new-issue trigger conditions and create sessions

slack_trigger_health_check.description: Detect Slack trigger feeds that have silently stopped firing and alert

github_trigger_health_check.description: Alert #eng-alerts when GitHub trigger polling has silently stopped succeeding

schedule_trigger.description: Check schedule triggers and create sessions when due

refresh_mcp_oauth_tokens.description: Proactively refresh MCP OAuth tokens before they expire

refresh_x_oauth_tokens.description: Proactively refresh X (Twitter) OAuth access tokens before they expire

transcript_archive.description: Incrementally build/update transcript archive zip file

warm_skills_cache.description: Warm the Claude skills cache for follow-up prompt slash command typeahead

cleanup_expired_elicitations.description: Expire pending elicitations past their expiration time

cleanup_runtime_login_attempts.description: Reap orphaned UI login attempts and prune old terminal rows

log_retention.description: Delete log rows past their retention window, so the logs table is bounded by time rather than by fleet activity

empty_trash.description: Permanently delete clones for trashed sessions past retention period

claude_code_update.description: Update Claude Code CLI to the latest version

status_summary_backstop.description: Re-run a status-summary generation that never landed, for sessions already at rest

abandoned_status_summary_fork_sweep.description: Archive status-summary forks that were created and never given their summary prompt

quota_reset_checker.description: Check if quota-exceeded accounts have reset and restore them to active

fleet_idle_checker.description: Fire the no_sessions_in_progress event once the fleet has been running fewer sessions than its ceiling for the configured stretch

spot_ceiling_sweep.description: Pause running spot sessions when a quota window reaches its target, and resume them when it falls

spot_hold_sweep.description: Put held spot sessions back on the re-check ladder when their re-check never fired

stalled_start_sweep.description: Re-enqueue the first turn of a session that has been waiting to start with no job behind it

stranded_sleep_sweep.description: Resume a session asleep in waiting on a wake-up that can never fire

burn_rate_recompute.description: Recompute the $/min burn rate of every harness+model combination from the token ledger

quota_capacity_calibration.description: Re-estimate what each Claude quota window is worth in Opus dollars, from spend over that window

claude_usage_sampler.description: Sample the serving Claude account's quota so the per-session usage rate has a time series

refresh_runtime_auth_tokens.description: Proactively refresh runtime login-credential tokens before they expire (fans out per runtime)

docker_cleanup.description: Clean up stale dev-server containers, prune old Docker images, and handle emergency disk situations

orphan_clone_filesystem_cleanup.description: Remove clone directories on disk with no matching session in the database

orphan_transcript_directory_cleanup.description: Remove runtime transcript directories whose working directory no longer exists

cleanup_stale_triggers.description: Destroy dead one-time wake-up triggers (archived target session, consumed-without-firing wake, or lapsed schedule)

zombie_reaper.description: Reap zombie subprocesses left by agent sessions (defense in depth alongside tini init shim)

cert_expiry_monitor.description: Check public TLS certs (ao/obs hosts) and alert when expiry nears — catches broken auto-renewal

system_health_monitor.description: Alert #eng-alerts when the GoodJob queue backlog is critical (sustained across checks)

egress_health_check.description: Probe the primary DNS resolver's public egress; drive the network-degraded banner

live_clone_integrity.description: Report live sessions whose clone directory has been deleted or stripped underneath them

mangled_clone_report.description: Report how many mangled clones the archive-side mass-deletion guard defused in the last day
